entries.title: Nehemiah 1:1
segments:
Chisleu; the ninth month, answering to apart of November and December. 
 
  In the twentieth year; of Artaxerxes' reign.
Shushan; a city in Persia, and the winter residence of the kings.

entries.title: Nehemiah 1:2
segments:
Came; from Jerusalem. 
 
True piety is sometimes found among those who are high in civil office; and it leads them to take a deep interest in the welfare of the people and cause of God, in all parts of the world, especially in the home of their ancestors and brethren.

entries.title: Nehemiah 1:5
segments: Prayer to the God of heaven froms the best preparation for great and difficult undertakings, and is the surest means of securing complete and final success.  Compare

entries.title: Nehemiah 1:7
segments: Hearty confession of sin, and an expression of firm confidence in the promises of God, are traits of acceptable prayer, and open the way for answers of peace.

entries.title: Nehemiah 1:9
segments: The place that I have chosen; Jerusalem.

entries.title: Nehemiah 1:10
segments: These are thy servants; the Israelites who had returned to Judea.

entries.title: Nehemiah 1:11
segments:
This man; the king of Persia. 
 
As teh hearts of all men are in the hand of the Lord, application to him is the surest way of obtaining favors from them.
